rules.name: Snapshot Consistency Requirement
rules.statement: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot must reflect the actual physical stock count at the specific store location within a maximum allowed latency of 30 seconds (proposed).
rules.condition: during any order allocation or validation activity
rules.if_violated: The system must block new order allocations and trigger an immediate manual audit of the store's physical inventory
rules.rationale: To prevent overselling and ensure accurate order fulfillment based on real-world availability

parameters.name: maximum allowed latency
parameters.description: The maximum time delay between a physical stock change and its reflection in the snapshot

rules.name: Reservation Release on Failure
rules.statement: Inventory reserved for a pending Fulfillment Task must be automatically released from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot if the task status transitions to failed or cancelled.
rules.condition: when a Fulfillment Task fails, is cancelled, or times out
exceptions: manual override by a Store Manager to hold stock
rules.if_violated: The system must flag the inventory record as 'stale' and prevent further order processing for that SKU until the reservation is manually cleared
rules.rationale: To prevent permanent stock locking and ensure availability for other customers when a delivery fails

parameters.name: timeout threshold
parameters.description: The maximum duration a failed task can hold a reservation before auto-release

rules.name: Forecast Data Integrity
rules.statement: Predictive demand forecasts must be recalculated exclusively using the latest validated Real-Time Inventory Snapshot data.
rules.condition: at the start of every daily forecasting cycle
exceptions: emergency manual override by a Senior Analyst
rules.if_violated: The forecast generation process must halt and generate a warning log indicating data source staleness
rules.rationale: To ensure resource allocation and replenishment plans are based on current, not historical, stock levels

parameters.name: recalculation frequency
parameters.description: How often the forecast engine runs against the snapshot

rules.name: Allocation Eligibility Threshold
rules.statement: An incoming Order Request may only be assigned to a Store Partner if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.
rules.condition: at the moment of order assignment or validation
exceptions: manual override by a Store Manager for high-priority customers
rules.if_violated: The order assignment must be rejected immediately and the customer notified of stock unavailability
rules.rationale: To guarantee that every assigned order can be physically fulfilled without partial shipments

parameters.name: minimum required quantity
parameters.description: The specific amount of each SKU needed to satisfy the order

rules.name: Slot Validity on Route Constraint
rules.statement: The system must invalidate an Assigned Delivery Slot if external network data indicates a route constraint.
rules.condition: When external logistics data signals a route constraint for the assigned path
exceptions: Manual override by Platform Operator for critical orders
rules.if_violated: The delivery task is re-allocated to an alternative agent or the order is cancelled
rules.rationale: Prevents agents from being assigned to impossible or severely delayed routes

parameters.name: route_constraint_threshold
parameters.description: Defines the severity of network delay that triggers invalidation

rules.name: Agent Capacity Real-Time Sync
rules.statement: The system must update agent capacity metrics continuously based on live location and speed data.
rules.condition: During the active delivery window for an Assigned Delivery Slot
rules.if_violated: Overbooking occurs, leading to missed delivery SLAs and customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate matching of order demand with available agent capacity

rules.name: Congestion-Driven Slot Rejection
rules.statement: The system must reject new Assigned Delivery Slot requests when demand exceeds supply in a specific zone.
rules.condition: When congestion alerts are triggered due to supply-demand imbalance
exceptions: Emergency medical or government priority orders
rules.if_violated: New orders are queued or rejected, increasing wait times
rules.rationale: Prevents saturation of the delivery network which degrades service quality

parameters.name: supply_demand_ratio
parameters.description: Threshold ratio where demand exceeds available supply

rules.name: Slot Duration Limit
rules.statement: An Assigned Delivery Slot must not exceed a maximum allowed duration defined by the delivery zone configuration.
rules.condition: At the moment the slot is created or extended
rules.if_violated: The slot is automatically truncated or the order is flagged for review
rules.rationale: Ensures adherence to the ultra-fast delivery promise and operational efficiency

parameters.name: max_slot_duration
parameters.description: Maximum time window allowed for a single delivery slot
